description: This is a white lamp with a cylindrical lampshade atop a stylized rhino head base. The rhino head is rendered in a low-poly, geometric style, giving it a modern and abstract appearance. The base is circular, providing stability. The overall design is minimalist and striking, intended to be a functional piece of art rather than a traditional lamp. The stark white color enhances its sculptural quality and allows it to blend with various decor styles while still making a statement.
